entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: De 6:1-25 . Moses Exhorts Israel to Hear God and to Keep His Commandments.

entries.heading: 20-25. when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying
entries.text: 20-25. when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying --The directions given for the instruction of their children form only an extension of the preceding counsels.
